    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0

    n_gen_tokens = output_ids.shape[1] - prompt_len
    return elapsed, n_gen_tokens


def compute_stats(times, tokens, base_mean=None):
    """Compute summary statistics from timing data."""
    t = np.array(times)
    tok = np.array(tokens)
    total_tokens = tok.sum()
    total_time = t.sum()
    stats = {
        "n_samples": len(t),
        "mean_s": float(t.mean()),
        "median_s": float(np.median(t)),
        "std_s": float(t.std()),
        "p95_s": float(np.percentile(t, 95)),
        "p99_s": float(np.percentile(t, 99)),
        "min_s": float(t.min()),
        "max_s": float(t.max()),
        "throughput_samples_per_sec": float(len(t) / total_time),
        "throughput_tokens_per_sec": float(total_tokens / total_time),
        "total_tokens": int(total_tokens),
        "mean_tokens_per_sample": float(tok.mean()),
    }
    if base_mean is not None and base_mean > 0:
        stats["overhead_vs_unconstrained_pct"] = float((t.mean() / base_mean - 1) * 100)
    return stats


def print_summary_table(results):
    """Print formatted summary table to terminal."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
    print(f"{'Mode':<15} {'N':>5} {'Mean(s)':>8} {'P50(s)':>8} {'P95(s)':>8} "
          f"{'P99(s)':>8} {'Overhead':>10} {'tok/s':>8}")
    print("-" * 90)

    base_mean = results.get("unconstrained", {}).get("mean_s")

    for mode in ALL_MODES:
        if mode not in results:
            continue
        s = results[mode]
        if mode == "unconstrained" or base_mean is None:
            overhead = "-"
        else:
            overhead = f"+{s.get('overhead_vs_unconstrained_pct', 0):.1f}%"
        print(f"{mode:<15} {s['n_samples']:>5} {s['mean_s']:>7.3f}s {s['median_s']:>7.3f}s "
              f"{s['p95_s']:>7.3f}s {s['p99_s']:>7.3f}s {overhead:>10} "
              f"{s['throughput_tokens_per_sec']:>7.1f}")
    print("=" * 90)


def main():
    args = parse_args()

    # Resolve paths
    defaults = DEFAULTS[args.dataset]
    model_path = args.model_path or defaults["model_path"]
    data_path = defaults["data_path"]
    constraints_path = defaults["constraints_path"]

    # Determine modes to run
    if args.all_modes:
        modes = ALL_MODES
    elif args.mode:
        modes = [args.mode]
    else:
        print("ERROR: specify --mode or --all_modes")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Load data
    print(f"[config] dataset={args.dataset}, model={model_path}")
    print(f"[config] modes={modes}, n_samples={args.n_samples}, device={args.device}")
    print("Loading data...")
    samples = load_data(args.dataset, data_path)
    total_available = len(samples)
    samples = samples[:args.n_samples]
    print(f"  {len(samples)} samples loaded (of {total_available} available)")

    # Load constraints
    spec = load_constraint_spec(constraints_path)
    print(f"  Schema: {len(spec.entity_types)} entity types, {len(spec.relation_types)} relation types")

    # Load model
    print("Loading model...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
    tokenizer.padding_side = "left"
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        model_path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        device_map=args.device, trust_remote_code=True,
    )
    model.eval()
    print(f"  Model loaded on {args.device}")

    ensure_first_token_map(spec, tokenizer)

    # Compile grammar if needed
    compiled_grammar = None
    if any(m in ("grammar_only", "full_s1") for m in modes):
        print("Compiling grammar...")
        compiled_grammar, compile_time = compile_grammar(spec, tokenizer, model)
        print(f"  Grammar compiled in {compile_time:.3f}s")

    # Warmup
    print(f"Warmup ({args.n_warmup} samples, unconstrained)...")
    for s in samples[:args.n_warmup]:
        run_one(model, tokenizer, s, spec, "unconstrained", None, args.max_new_tokens, args.dataset)
    print("  Warmup done")

    # Profile each mode
    all_raw = {}
    all_stats = {}

    for mode in modes:
        print(f"\n>>> Profiling: {mode} ({len(samples)} samples)")
        times = []
        tokens = []
        cg = compiled_grammar if mode in ("grammar_only", "full_s1") else None

        for i, sample in enumerate(samples):
            elapsed, n_tok = run_one(
                model, tokenizer, sample, spec, mode, cg, args.max_new_tokens, args.dataset
            )
            times.append(elapsed)
            tokens.append(n_tok)
            if (i + 1) % 20 == 0:
                print(f"  [{i+1}/{len(samples)}] last={elapsed:.2f}s, "
                      f"mean_so_far={np.mean(times):.2f}s")

        all_raw[mode] = {"times": times, "tokens": tokens}

    # Compute stats
    base_mean = None
    if "unconstrained" in all_raw:
        base_mean = np.mean(all_raw["unconstrained"]["times"])

    for mode in modes:
        all_stats[mode] = compute_stats(
            all_raw[mode]["times"], all_raw[mode]["tokens"], base_mean
        )

    # Print summary
    print_summary_table(all_stats)

    # Statistical tests if we have baseline
    if "unconstrained" in all_raw and len(modes) > 1:
        from scipy import stats as sp_stats
        print("\n--- Paired t-test vs unconstrained ---")
        base_times = np.array(all_raw["unconstrained"]["times"])
        for mode in modes:
            if mode == "unconstrained":
                continue
            mode_times = np.array(all_raw[mode]["times"])
            stat, pval = sp_stats.ttest_rel(base_times, mode_times)
            diff = mode_times - base_times
            print(f"  {mode}: diff_mean={diff.mean():+.4f}s "
                  f"({(diff.mean()/base_times.mean())*100:+.1f}%), p={pval:.6f}")

    # Save JSON output
    if args.output_path:
        out_path = args.output_path
    else:
        mode_str = "all" if args.all_modes else modes[0]
        out_path = f"/tmp/profile_latency_{args.dataset}_{mode_str}.json"

    output = {
        "config": {
            "dataset": args.dataset,
            "model_path": model_path,
            "n_samples": len(samples),
            "n_warmup": args.n_warmup,
            "max_new_tokens": args.max_new_tokens,
            "device": args.device,
            "modes": modes,
        },
        "stats": all_stats,
        "raw": {mode: {"times": all_raw[mode]["times"], "tokens": all_raw[mode]["tokens"]}
                for mode in modes},
    }
    if compiled_grammar is not None:
        output["config"]["grammar_compile_time_s"] = compile_time

    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(output, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
